correctness.rationale: For C16(1,4,8), independently enumerated 65536 vertex masks, recovering 16,80,144,80 nonempty faces by dimensions 0..3. The supplied explicit eighty-facet shelling list exhausts all facets and the inspected exact verifier checks each added facet has nonempty pure codimension-one overlap; reduced Euler -1 gives K~S3 and simple connectivity. A nontrivial rotation orbit of size <=4 necessarily has step 4 or 8 and cannot sit inside an independent face, proving free C16 action; exhaustive independent face-invariance test agrees. The two reflections s0(j)=-j and s1(j)=1-j fix vertex 0 and midpoint of edge {2,15}, respectively, and generate D16; Armstrong orbit-space theorem yields pi1 D16 quotient trivial. Locally replayed the COMPLETE pinned `verify_quotients.py`, byte verified against actual Git blob SHA 91478a2a11e8c202f62e01f7c980775e5d4e491f. It constructs all barycentric flags (320,2144,3744,1920), both orbit-cell bases, signed boundaries and proves boundary compositions zero; exact integral Smith factors are cyclic ∂1=1^19, ∂2=1^114 and 16^1, ∂3=1^119, and dihedral ∂1=1^15,∂2=1^58,∂3=1^59. Therefore cyclic H1=Z/16, H0=H3=Z, dihedral H0=H3=Z only. Hurewicz and homology-Whitehead for simply connected finite CW quotient imply its homotopy equivalence to S3. No lens-space homeomorphism or linking form is implied.
